title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
坚盾剑怪上，解说员李冰松了一口气。这钱真烫手呀。他是真不知道怎么解说，他只能从乘龙的优点上疯狂入手。否则，让他夸训练家，怎么夸？夸他在对战场地上吃薯片？别开玩笑了...要不是最近缺钱，李冰还真不想干这活。‘话说这一轮比赛完了，也没看到几个不错的新人训练家呀？’他晃荡在九个场地的周围，等待着第四场比赛的开始。“嗯？八号场地有只杰尼龟和一只妙蛙种子。”他飘过来准备解说，“让我们看向八号场地哈，难得一见，八号场地的训练家，既然各自都有着一只御三家的宝可梦，这是杰尼龟和妙蛙种子之间的决斗！”下面，张小明看着放出来，有些许不一样的杰尼龟，脸色一顿。但又看不出来哪里不一样。想着刚刚在选手席位上被执法人员教训的模样，他的表情阴沉了下来。这都怪那个出现在秦姝身边，被秦姝叫做“枫哥”的家伙。要是没有他，秦姝怎么会拒绝他？他狠声道：“都说了你的杰尼龟是打不过我的妙蛙种子的！”“哼。”秦姝并没有理他，娇润的脸蛋上多了几分畅快，一张小嘴不由得上扬了起来。果然，还是枫哥说的对，对这种人，不理会就行了。至于打不打得过...伴随着一道比赛开始的声音，她当即就下达了口令，“杰尼龟，发挥出你这几天的特训结果，水枪。”张小明发出一声嗤笑，“就凭你杰尼龟的水枪，怎么可能打的中我....”“卧槽？”只是，他的笑声还没有完全发出，一道凌冽的水枪，就已经落在了妙蛙种子的身上，水枪速度之快，之精准，直接让妙蛙种子发出了痛鸣声，“种子，种子？！”同时，目光中带着几分不可思议的目光看向杰尼龟，前几天的杰尼龟，水枪打在它身上还没有一点感觉的...怎么可能一下子，就变得这么疼了？“好，杰尼龟，再来一发！”见到成效，秦姝惊喜道。

“快...快躲开...”虽然张小明急忙下达命令，可如今，已经遭受一击的妙蛙种子，再想要躲避已经经过无数次被藤藤蛇特训过来的水枪，已经是不可能了。在上面观看完全部过程的李冰不由得心中夸赞道，“咦，这只杰尼龟不错呀，对水枪的掌握程度这么完善？”就是有个点他比较疑惑。“不过...怎么有点不像是这个女生能培育出来的水准呢？”因为脸上的惊喜，好似完全不知道杰尼龟能打出这样的水准一般...算了，还是去看看其它组吧。他摇摇头，不再多想，让坚盾剑怪带着飞向第九组.......“可恶，穿山鼠，使用组合技。”寸头男子充满惊疑的看着眼前的藤藤蛇。对战到现在为之，他已经让穿山鼠用了三个技能。滚动，毒针和连斩。可没有一个技能对对方的藤藤蛇造成任何的威胁。滚动，毒针被轻巧的躲开。连斩则被刀叶抵挡住。对方好像不似在跟穿山鼠对战，而是将穿山鼠当成了磨刀石一般的存在。“可以了吧？”看着有些了然的藤藤蛇，林枫的常磐之力传递过去。“藤藤~。”藤藤蛇点了点头，他轻描淡写的道：“那就使用藤鞭吧。”哪怕是滚动的穿山鼠在这个时候，已经展开身形，并且借助滚动带来的惯性高高跃起，爪子上冒着森然的白光。可下一刻，两条青绿色的鞭子跟打木制的陀螺一般，将它狠狠的甩飞出去。力道之大，直接甩飞了十几米远。这就是藤藤蛇的藤鞭！它在速度的个体值上，已经点满。再加上“拔草”带来的熟练度，几乎是呼吸之间，就能释放出强有力的鞭打！寸头男子原本看着藤藤蛇面对穿山鼠的组合技竟然都不躲的时候，嘴角已经扬起了笑容。可现在，被寄予厚望的组合技被一下子抽飞，这让他睁大了眼睛，“开什么玩笑？怎么可能？”倒地的穿山鼠，仅仅只是吃了一道鞭打，就有些站不起来的趋势了。这让寸头男子眼睛瞪的更大了。自己的穿山鼠，

Entering the Strong Shield Sword Monster, the commentator Li Bing breathed a sigh of relief.This money is so hot.He really didn't know how to explain it. He could only start from the advantages of Chenglong.Otherwise, if he is asked to praise the trainer, how can he praise him?Compliment him for eating potato chips on the battlefield?Don't be kidding... If it weren't for the lack of money recently, Li Bing really wouldn't want to do this job.‘By the way, this round of competition is over, and we haven’t seen a few good new trainers?’ He wandered around the nine courts, waiting for Game 4 to begin."Huh? There is a Squirtle and a Bulbasaur on Site 8." He floated over to explain, "Let's look at Site 8. It's rare to see that the trainers on Site 8 each have a Pokémon from the three royal families. This is a duel between Squirtle and Bulbasaur!" Below, Zhang Xiaoming looked at the slightly different Squirtle that had been released, and his face paused.But I can't tell what's different.Thinking about how he had just been scolded by the law enforcement officers in the player's seat, his expression darkened.This is all because of the guy who appeared next to Qin Shu and was called "Brother Feng" by Qin Shu.Without him, how could Qin Shu reject him?He said harshly: "I told you that your Squirtle can't beat my Bulbasaur!" "Humph." Qin Shu ignored him, her delicate face felt a little more happy, and her small mouth couldn't help but raise.Sure enough, Brother Feng was right, just ignore this kind of person.As for whether she can beat me... With the sound of the start of the game, she immediately gave the command, "Squirtle, show off the results of your special training these days, water gun." Zhang Xiaoming sneered, "With your Squirtle's water gun, how could you hit me..." "What the hell?" However, before his laughter could be fully released, a stream of cold water came out.The gun had already landed on Bulbasaur. The water gun was so fast and accurate that Bulbasaur screamed in pain, "Seed, seed?!" At the same time, he looked at Squirtle with a somewhat unbelievable look in his eyes. Squirtle didn't feel anything when the water gun hit him a few days ago... How could it become so painful all of a sudden?"Okay, Squirtle, let's do it again!" Qin Shu said in surprise after seeing the results.

"Quickly...dodge...quickly..." Although Zhang Xiaoming hurriedly issued the order, it was already impossible for Bulbasaur, who had already suffered a blow, to dodge the water gun that had been specially trained by Vine Snake countless times.Li Bing, who was watching the whole process from above, couldn't help but praise in his heart, "Hey, this Squirtle is pretty good. How well does it master the water gun?" There was just one point where he was confused."But... why doesn't it look like the level that this girl can cultivate?" Because of the surprise on his face, it was as if he didn't know that Squirtle could achieve such a level... Forget it, let's go and see other groups.He shook his head, thought no more, and let the Shield Sword Monster fly towards the ninth group... "Damn it, pangolin, use combo skills." The short-haired man looked at the vine snake in front of him in surprise.So far in the battle, he has asked the pangolin to use three skills.Rolling, poisonous needle and combo.But none of the skills pose any threat to the opponent's Vine Snake.Rolling, the poisonous needle was easily dodged.The continuous slashes were blocked by the blade.The opponent didn't seem to be fighting against the pangolin, but rather used the pangolin as a whetstone."Is that okay?" Lin Feng passed on the power of Viridian as he looked at the somewhat understanding Vine Snake."Vine~." The Vine Snake nodded, and he said lightly: "Then use the Vine Whip." Even the rolling pangolin had already spread out its body at this time, and jumped high with the help of the inertia brought by the rolling, with a dark white light on its claws.But the next moment, two turquoise whips were like hitting wooden tops, flinging it away fiercely.The force was so strong that it was thrown away more than ten meters.This is the vine whip of the Vine Snake!Its individual value of speed is already full.Coupled with the proficiency brought by "pulling weeds", you can release a powerful whip almost in a breath!When the short-haired man saw that the Vine Snake did not even dodge the Pangolin Rat's combo, a smile appeared on his lips.But now, the combo he had high hopes for was suddenly knocked away, which made him open his eyes wide, "Are you kidding? How is it possible?" The pangolin that fell to the ground was unable to stand up after just a whip.This made the short-haired man's eyes widen even more.My own pangolin,
